# Nutrition Plan for Muscle Building (Vegetarian & Gluten-Free)

## Daily Calorie & Macro Targets
- **Calories**: ~2,500-2,800/day (depending on activity level)
- **Protein**: 120-150g/day (1.6-2g per kg bodyweight)
- **Carbs**: 300-375g/day
- **Fats**: 70-90g/day

## Protein Sources (Essential)
- Greek yogurt & cottage cheese
- Eggs & egg whites
- Legumes: lentils, chickpeas, black beans
- Tofu & tempeh
- Quinoa
- Nuts & seeds
- Protein powder (whey or plant-based)

## Quality Carbs (Gluten-Free)
- Rice, quinoa, potatoes
- Oats (certified gluten-free)
- Corn, sweet potatoes
- Fruits & berries

## Healthy Fats
- Olive oil, avocado oil
- Nuts & nut butters
- Seeds (chia, flax, pumpkin)
- Avocados

## Sample Day Structure
- **Breakfast**: Eggs + oats + berries
- **Snack**: Greek yogurt + granola
- **Lunch**: Lentil bowl + rice + vegetables
- **Snack**: Protein shake + fruit
- **Dinner**: Tofu/tempeh stir-fry + quinoa

**Important**: Combine this with strength training and adequate sleep for optimal results.

# Nutrition Plan for Endurance Training

## Daily Calorie Intake
**2,800-3,200 calories/day** (depending on training intensity)
- Your BMR is ~1,900 cal; endurance training adds 900-1,300 cal

## Macronutrient Breakdown

| Nutrient | Amount | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| **Carbs** | 55-60% (385-480g) | Primary fuel for endurance |
| **Protein** | 15-17% (105-135g) | Recovery & muscle maintenance |
| **Fat** | 20-25% (62-89g) | Energy & hormone production |

## Food Priorities

**Complex Carbs** (emphasized for endurance)
- Oats, rice, quinoa, whole grain bread
- Sweet potatoes, beans, lentils
- Pasta, barley

**Lean Proteins**
- Chicken, turkey, fish
- Eggs, Greek yogurt, cottage cheese
- Legumes

**Healthy Fats**
- Olive oil, avocados, nuts
- Fatty fish (salmon, mackerel)
- Seeds

**Fruits & Vegetables**
- For carbs, electrolytes, antioxidants

## Timing Tip
- Pre-workout: carbs + moderate protein (2-3 hrs before)
- Post-workout: carbs + protein within 30-60 min

**Note:** Adjust based on actual training volume and performance. Consider consulting a sports nutritionist for personalized optimization.

# Realistic Assessment First

**Losing 3kg in 2 weeks is aggressive and risky.** This is ~1.5kg/week, mostly unsustainable water/muscle loss. For competition, this approach risks:
- Performance decline
- Dehydration
- Muscle loss
- Injury/fatigue

**Better approach:** Lose 1-1.5kg now, achieve final 1.5kg through controlled dehydration 24-48 hours before weigh-in (with medical supervision).

---

## If Proceeding Carefully

**Calorie deficit:** ~500-750 kcal/day below maintenance (likely 2500-2800 kcal)
- Target: ~1800-2000 kcal/day
- Prioritize protein to minimize muscle loss

### Sample Daily Structure

**Protein sources** (prioritize these):
- Lean meat/fish (chicken, turkey, salmon, lean beef)
- Eggs
- Plant-based: lentils, chickpeas, tofu, tempeh
- Protein powder (pea/rice based)

**Sample meals:**
- **Breakfast:** Eggs + rice cakes + berries
- **Lunch:** Grilled chicken + sweet potato + vegetables
- **Snack:** Protein shake (non-dairy) + fruit
- **Dinner:** Fish + brown rice + broccoli

**Hydration:** 3-4L daily (don't dehydrate early)

---

## Critical: Consult your coach/sports nutritionist
They should oversee this protocol given competition demands.
